tutorial.chapter01.headline: Aim of the game
tutorial.chapter01.step01.headline: Learning the game
tutorial.chapter01.step01.text01: In this tutorial, you’re going to learn both how to play a game of Blood Rage and how to interact with the digital version.
tutorial.chapter01.step01.text02: The order of this tutorial does not represent the same order the game is played in. Instead, it introduces concepts step by step to make the game as accessible as possible.
tutorial.chapter01.step02.headline: Victory condition
tutorial.chapter01.step02.text01: Collecting Glory is how players win in Blood Rage. At the end of the game, the player with the most Glory wins.
tutorial.chapter01.step02.text02: You gain glory through victory in battle, through pillaging, accomplishing quests for the gods and dying valiantly in battle.
tutorial.chapter01.step03.headline: The Three Ages
tutorial.chapter01.step03.text01:
The game is played in three Ages, and each Age consists of 2 main phases:

Gods’ Gift Phase: players draft their cards for the coming Age
Action Phase: players spend their Rage to do various actions
tutorial.chapter02.headline: Invading
tutorial.chapter02.step01.headline: Invading
tutorial.chapter02.step01.text01: The only way to get figures onto the board is to Invade with them. Invading means placing a figure from your reserve on the board in any of the provinces apart from Yggdrasil.
tutorial.chapter02.step02.headline: Villages
tutorial.chapter02.step02.text01: Every province on the board consists of between three and five villages. Only villages can be occupied in provinces, and there can only be one figure per village.
tutorial.chapter02.step03.headline: Placing figures and Rage
tutorial.chapter02.step03.text01: Placing figures costs their Strength in Rage. Rage is your ‘currency’ in Blood Rage; once you’re out of it, you can’t act anymore for the rest of the Age.
tutorial.chapter02.step03.text02: An exception to this rule is your Leader - you can always invade with your Leader for free.
tutorial.chapter02.step04.headline: Figure limit
tutorial.chapter02.step04.text01: One of your three clan stats is ‘Horns’. Horns determines how many figures you can have on the board at the same time. Increase it to grow your army!
tutorial.chapter02.step04.text02: You can place up to 1 leader, 8 warriors and 1 ship during an age if you have enough horns. If a figure dies, you must wait till the next age to get it back.
tutorial.chapter02.step05.headline: Rage & player turn
tutorial.chapter02.step05.text01: As soon as you run out of Rage, you can’t take any actions anymore, not even actions that cost 0 Rage (like Pillage).
tutorial.chapter02.task03: Click on one of the remaining villages in Elvagar
tutorial.chapter03.headline: Pillaging
tutorial.chapter03.step01.headline: Pillaging & Battle
tutorial.chapter03.step01.text01: Pillaging is a way to both win Glory and also to improve your clan’s stats.
tutorial.chapter03.step02.headline: Stat increases
tutorial.chapter03.step02.text01: Every time you successfully pillage, you’ll get the region’s reward, which will increase one of the three stats (Rage, Axes, Horns).
tutorial.chapter03.step02.text02: One province in the game won’t give you a stat increase, but instead increase your Glory immediately by 5.
tutorial.chapter03.step02.text03: Pillaging Yggdrasil will give you a much bigger reward: you’ll be able to increase all three stats by 1.
tutorial.chapter03.step03.headline: Player strength
tutorial.chapter03.step03.text01: A quick way to judge your chances in battle is by evaluating the strength of everybody present in the province. Just hover over the province to see it.
tutorial.chapter03.step04.task01: Check the player strength in Elvagar
tutorial.chapter03.step05.headline: Call to Battle
tutorial.chapter03.step05.text01: Once a player has declared his intent to Pillage a province, the other players have a chance to join the battle if they wish. They may move one of their figures from an adjacent province into an empty village in the pillaging province.
tutorial.chapter03.step05.text02: Once all villages in that province are occupied, or when no one else wishes to join in, the battle begins.
tutorial.chapter03.step05.text03: Note: There are no villages in Yggdrasil, so any number of figures can join a battle there.
tutorial.chapter03.step06.headline: Combat strength & cards
tutorial.chapter03.step06.text01:
Each player participating in the battle must choose a card from his hand, then all cards are revealed simultaneously. Players who reveal battle cards apply their effects and add a +STR bonus to the total STR of their figures in the battle. If a player reveals an Upgrade, a Monster or a Quest, it has no effect.
Some special Battle cards can be used even after players have revealed their cards.
tutorial.chapter03.step06.text02: Some special Battle cards can be used to further increase the Strength of your troops even after players have revealed their cards. These special cards have their STR bonus on a solid white disc, and they indicate in the card text that they can be played after cards are revealed but before determining a winner (they can also be played normally). The pillaging player has the first chance to add Strength from one of these special cards, and it proceeds clockwise around the table from there until nobody wants to play any.
tutorial.chapter03.step07.task01: Choose Tyr's Smite to play by double clicking it
tutorial.chapter03.step08.headline: Loss of cards
tutorial.chapter03.step08.text01: The winner of the battle (if any) must discard all cards he played. The losers of the battle take all of their played cards back into their hands.
tutorial.chapter03.step09.headline: Axes & Glory
tutorial.chapter03.step09.text01: The winner of the battle gains Glory, whether he’s the pillaging player or not. The number of Glory points they get is equal to their current Axes stat, as indicated on their player bar.
tutorial.chapter03.step10.headline: Stat increases
tutorial.chapter03.step10.text01:
While talking about Pillaging earlier, we also talked about stat increases:

More Rage allows you to do more action
More Axes allows you more glory for each battle you win
More Horns allows you to deploy more figures

At the end of the game you will also receive an extra +10 or +20 Glory depending on how high you raised your stats.
tutorial.chapter03.step10.text02: You can always check how far you’re on the track during the game while hovering over your player stats to display the tracks.
tutorial.chapter03.step11.description: Click on the Battle Summary button
tutorial.chapter03.step11.headline: Open Battle Summary
tutorial.chapter03.step12.headline: Close the Overview
tutorial.chapter03.step13.headline: Close the Battleshield
tutorial.chapter05.headline: Marching
tutorial.chapter05.step01.headline: Marching
tutorial.chapter05.step01.text01: When you order your troops to March, you must pay 1 Rage. Choose one province and move any number of figures from this province to another one. The two provinces don’t have to be adjacent, the target province can anywhere on the board.
tutorial.chapter05.step03.quest01: March your Troll from Angerboda to Muspelheim
tutorial.chapter04.headline: Upgrades & Monsters
tutorial.chapter04.step01.headline: Clan Upgrades
tutorial.chapter04.step01.text01: In this chapter, we’ll take a look at how to play clan upgrade cards. Upgrade cards bestow certain abilities on your clan.
tutorial.chapter04.step02.quest01: Play Frigga’s Charm in an upgrade slot
tutorial.chapter04.step02.task01: Drag & drop card into an empty upgrade slot
tutorial.chapter04.step04.headline: Monster cards
tutorial.chapter04.step04.text01:
Monsters are unique figures with powerful abilities that can dramatically change the course of the game. When you play a Monster, it is yours for the rest of the game, counting as one of your figures but you can have only 2 Monsters at a time.

Monsters are considered normal figures, so they can invade, die, return to your reserve for the next age or gain glory for you during Ragnarök phase. If you discard a Monster’s card to place a new Monster in the Upgrade slot, the old one is removed from the game.
tutorial.chapter04.step05.task01: Select the Troll card from your hand and place it in a monster slot
tutorial.chapter04.step08.headline: Unopposed Pillages
tutorial.chapter04.step08.text01: When you claim all villages in a province or nobody wants to follow your Call to Battle to oppose you, you will get an unopposed Pillage. It is an easy way to earn stat increases, with no risk to lose a battle and no need to use a card to win, but you will gain no Glory as a reward either.
tutorial.chapter04.step10.headline: Gaining Rage
tutorial.chapter04.step10.text01: Even though you gained Rage, this only increased your Rage stat - what this means is that you don’t immediately gain more Rage to spend this round. The increase will only take effect once the new round rolls around.
tutorial.chapter06.headline: Questing
tutorial.chapter06.step01.headline: Quest Cards
tutorial.chapter06.step01.text01: Playing a Quest card does not cost any rage. Just place the card on the Quest card slot and try and fulfill the Quest during the current age to reap the benefits.
tutorial.chapter06.step01.text02: There is no limit to the number of Quest cards you can play, and it’s also possible to play multiple versions of the same card. There is no penalty for failing a Quest.
tutorial.chapter06.step02.task01: Drag & drop quest card into the quest card slot
tutorial.chapter06.step03.headline: Fulfilling Quests
tutorial.chapter06.step03.text01: Fulfilling Quests is a good way both to gain extra Glory and to boost your clan stats. To do that you need to complete specific objectives (eg: have the most strength in a province belonging to a specific region). Be careful! Ragnarök can increase or decrease the interest of specific provinces, if some are already destroyed.
tutorial.chapter07.headline: Ships & Fjords
tutorial.chapter07.step01.headline: Ships & Fjords
tutorial.chapter07.step01.text01: Ships can only ever be placed in fjords. Ships can not March, and each fjord is said to be supporting the two provinces that it is connected to. Any effect that affects a province also affects its supporting fjord. There is no limit to the number of Ship figures that can occupy each fjord.
tutorial.chapter07.step02.quest01: Place your ship to secure Manheim
tutorial.chapter07.step02.task01: Click the fjord between Elvagar & Angerboda to place your ship
tutorial.chapter08.headline: Passing
tutorial.chapter08.step01.headline: Passing
tutorial.chapter08.step01.text01: If you don’t want to do anything else during an age, even if you still have Rage, you can Pass and decline to take any more actions during the current Age. Passing will reduce your Rage to 0 and you won’t be able to take action anymore.
tutorial.chapter08.step02.task01: Click on the Age banner and pass your turn
tutorial.chapter09.headline: End of an Age
tutorial.chapter09.step01.headline: End of an Age
tutorial.chapter09.step01.text01: At the end of each Age, there are a number of special phases the game runs through.
tutorial.chapter09.step02.headline: Discard phase
tutorial.chapter09.step02.text01:
First, players have to discard their hands down to one card. The card they keep does not have to be from the current Age, it could also be from the First Age.
No player may keep more than one card.
tutorial.chapter09.step04.headline: Quest phase
tutorial.chapter09.step04.text01:
In this phase, the game checks whether any Quests have been fulfilled and hands out the rewards for any successful ones.
You get to choose one of the three clan stats for an increase.
tutorial.chapter09.step05.task01:
Click on the Horns "+"
and then on Confirm
tutorial.chapter09.step06.headline: Ragnarök phase
tutorial.chapter09.step06.text01:
In this phase, the Doomed province gets destroyed, and all figures in it and adjacent fjords are sent to Valhalla. Players will receive a certain amount of Glory for each destroyed figure, depending on the Age.
The villages in the Doomed Province are highlighted by a golden glow.
tutorial.chapter09.step07.headline: Release Valhalla
tutorial.chapter09.step07.text01:
Now, all figures are released from Valhalla and returned to their owners to once again come to Midgard during the next Age and fight once more!
If, during the game, you want to check what has already gone to Valhalla, you can check the Valhalla menu
tutorial.chapter09.step08.task01: Click on the Valhalla banner in the upper right corner
tutorial.chapter09.step09.task01: Take a look at the entries, then click again on the Valhalla banner
tutorial.chapter10.headline: Gift of the Gods
tutorial.chapter10.step01.headline: The Gods’ Gift phase
tutorial.chapter10.step01.text01:
During this phase, players draft the cards they will use during the coming Age. Each player receives several cards and gets to choose one to keep, passing the other ones to the next players. This will be repeated until each player has picked six cards.

At the end of the First and Second Age, each player gets to keep one card from their hand, the others are discarded. 
Note that the cards in play vary according to player count.
tutorial.chapter10.step03.headline: Draft strategies
tutorial.chapter10.step03.text01: In the compendium, you will find an overview of different archetypes for drafting strategies. These archetypes allow you to discover and try advanced strategies against the AI or other players. Some cards are easy to use and master, but others are more complex; making the best use of them is half the fun of Blood Rage, though.
tutorial.chapter10.step05.headline: End tutorial
tutorial.chapter10.step05.text01: Even though the Gods' Gift phase isn't over yet, we're going to end the tutorial here. We suggest you start your own game now and try to draft yourself a powerful hand to compete with all the other clans!
tutorial.chapter11.headline: End of Tutorial
tutorial.chapter11.step01.headline: End of tutorial
tutorial.chapter11.step01.text01:
Now you know everything you need to know to play a game of Blood Rage. In the Compendium, you’ll find not only all the rules for the game, but also all the cards and some strategic tips for playing the game.
If you’d like to learn more, please check it out. Otherwise, we hope you enjoy your games.
tutorial.description: In this tutorial, you'll learn how to play the game and how to use the controls. You can come back to it at a later time and continue if you can't do it in one sitting.
tutorial.headline: Tutorial for playing Blood Rage
tutorial.chapter03.step04.task02: Pillage Elvagar by clicking on the banner
tutorial.chapter07.step01.text02:
Because it is not possible to move Ships once placed, you need to be careful with them.
They are more powerful than your basic Warriors (but also more expensive), and can influence both adjacent provinces, so Ships can be a huge measure of control for those provinces.
tutorial.chapter07.step01.text03: But since you can also be drawn into fights in both provinces, it is also quite easy to lose your Ship when you're not careful. So consider well where you want to spend the 2 Rage to place your Ship!
